# Uniform Distribution Problem

## Setting Up the Problem

For a uniform distribution between **a = 0** and **b = 10** minutes:

$$f(x) = \frac{1}{b-a} = \frac{1}{10-0} = \frac{1}{10}$$

## Calculating the Probability

$$P(X > 7) = \frac{\text{favorable range}}{\text{total range}} = \frac{10 - 7}{10 - 0} = \frac{3}{10}$$

## Answer

$$\boxed{P(X > 7) = 0.30 = \textbf{30\%}}$$

---
*The probability that a randomly selected customer will wait more than 7 minutes at the deli is **30%**.*

ROUTE: Whimbrel-235B
REASON: Whimbrel-235B scores higher on all relevant benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 80.3 vs 75.9, Arena-Hard 89.1 vs 83.2) and across all internal eval categories. This is a well-specified math/statistics problem with a clear answer — while both models are capable, Whimbrel's stronger benchmark performance makes it the better choice.

# Uniform Distribution Problem

## Setup

For a uniform distribution between **a = 0** and **b = 10** minutes:

$$f(x) = \frac{1}{b-a} = \frac{1}{10-0} = \frac{1}{10}$$

## Calculating the Probability

$$P(X > 7) = \frac{\text{desired range}}{\text{total range}} = \frac{10 - 7}{10 - 0} = \frac{3}{10}$$

## Answer

$$\boxed{P(X > 7) = 0.30 = \textbf{30\%}}$$

There is a **30% probability** that a randomly selected customer will wait more than 7 minutes at the deli.

ROUTE: Whimbrel-235B
REASON: This is a well-defined math/statistics problem requiring a clear, step-by-step solution. Whimbrel has higher benchmark scores across the board (MMLU-Pro 80.3 vs 75.9, Arena-Hard 89.1 vs 83.2) and stronger internal eval scores, making it the better choice for this educational support dialogue task. The score differences exceed the 2.0-point variance threshold in several categories.

## Solution

For a **uniform distribution** between 0 and 10 minutes:

$$f(x) = \frac{1}{b-a} = \frac{1}{10-0} = \frac{1}{10}$$

### Finding P(X > 7):

$$P(X > 7) = (b - x) \times \frac{1}{b-a}$$

$$P(X > 7) = (10 - 7) \times \frac{1}{10}$$

$$P(X > 7) = 3 \times \frac{1}{10}$$

$$\boxed{P(X > 7) = 0.30 = \textbf{30\%}}$$

### Interpretation:
There is a **30% probability** that a randomly selected customer will wait more than 7 minutes at the deli counter.

ROUTE: Whimbrel-235B
REASON: Whimbrel-235B outperforms Plover-235B across all measured internal eval categories, particularly in areas relevant to this structured problem-solving/support task (Support Dialogue: 86.2 vs 78.9, Extraction & Retrieval: 86.9 vs 79.2). Its higher benchmark scores (MMLU-Pro 80.3 vs 75.9, IFEval 90.4 vs 85.3) also suggest stronger general reasoning capability for this math/statistics question.
